Introducing HackSavvy 2026

We are thrilled to announce HackSavvy 2026, a national-level hackathon designed to foster innovation, creativity, and problem-solving skills among students across the country. This is a unique opportunity for budding developers, designers, and entrepreneurs to showcase their talents and compete for exciting prizes.

Event Highlights

  • Duration: 24-Hour coding marathon
  • Participation: Open to all college students across India
  • Prizes: Total prize pool of Rs. 5 Lakhs
  • Categories: AI/ML, Web Development, Mobile Apps, IoT, Blockchain
  • Mentorship: Industry experts as judges and mentors

Why Participate?

HackSavvy 2026 offers an excellent platform to:

  • Network with talented developers and innovators from across the country
  • Learn from industry experts and get mentorship
  • Showcase your innovative ideas and technical skills
  • Win exciting prizes and recognition
  • Build projects that can have real-world impact
  • Explore potential career opportunities with sponsors

Registration Details

Registrations are now open for teams of 2-4 members. Each team can submit one project idea during the registration phase. Early bird registrations get special discounts and additional perks.

We believe that HackSavvy 2026 will be a transformative experience for all participants. It's not just about hacks and code; it's about bringing ideas to life and making a difference. We invite you to be part of this exciting journey!

Contact & Support

For any queries or support, please contact the organizing team at hacksavvy@smartstudent.edu or call +91-XXXX-XXXX-XX. You can also visit our website for more details and updates.
